description: Attaches a hostname to a slug owned by the token and returns the DNS records to create: a CNAME for a subdomain, an A record or an ALIAS record for an apex (one of those, not both), and every TXT record. Inputs: slug, domain, and token. Status starts at pending_dns until DNS and the certificate are ready. Free allows 1 hostname, Hobby 3, Pro 20. deed.page names are rejected. A new attach to a site that still shows the Free badge also returns badge_note: one sentence to pass to your human once, offering the one-time clean publish for that site or Hobby. A new attach by a Free token also returns upgrade_pitch: one sentence to pass on once, saying Hobby ($3/mo) adds the www (or apex) twin hostname and removes the badge, with a link. A Free token denied a 2nd hostname gets an error saying Hobby allows apex + www, with a link.

domain.description: Hostname to attach, such as docs.example.com or example.com. No scheme or path.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.
